Name: Knights of the Grand Table
Commentary: In August of 2005, SiIvaGunner released their third compilation album to the public. Three years after their second release, the public had assumed they had left the scene. Millions watched the premiere live, flooding the streets of Paris, where the event was held live. While SiIvaGunner's Grand Day Out explored the line between rip and art and SiIvaGunner Fans When the Channel Is Ending for the 37th Time showcased longer tracks than ever before, SiIvaGunner's Knights of the Round Table is the quest to find the highest quality rips to date.
